title: Paramasivan
desc: A man waits to meet his fate after being sentenced to death for killing six policemen. However, an officer asks him to help catch a terrorist group.

title: Kutty
desc: When Kutty falls for Geeta, he decides to confess his feelings but is left heartbroken to discover her relationship with her classmate Arjun.

title: Iruvar
desc: An actor's and a writer's friendship is ruined when they compete for the same political post.

title: Appavi
desc: Bharathi, a man who leads a double life, is a college student by day and a vigilante who kills corrupt politicians by night. When a minister's daughter falls for him, matters get worse.

title: Maharasan
desc: Selvi falls in love with Vadivelu, a butcher. Realising that Vadivelu has to get his sister married first, Selvi helps him find an ideal life partner for his sister.
